newsitem.title: USA: Alaris Medical in talks to resolve dispute.
newsitem.headline: Alaris Medical in talks to resolve dispute.

text.p: ALARIS Medical Inc. Tuesday said it is proceeding with negotiations to resolve a dispute with Cal Pacifico, a Newport Beach, Calif.-based, maquiladora contracting firm.

In a statement, the company said it has implemented contingency plans to manage inventory levels and is establishing alternative manufacturing in other sites. At this point, the company said it does not anticipate the dispute will have an effect on customers or results of its operations for the second quarter.

ALARIS Medical Systems Inc., the company's operating subsidiary, has manufactured its disposable intravenous-administration sets in two maquiladora plants in Tijuana under contract with Cal Pacifico for more than eight years.

The facilities, which operate under a "shelter program" with Cal Pacifico and two affiliated Mexican companies, Ensambles Medicos S.A. de C.V. and Arplamed S.A. de C.V., employ more than 1,200 workers.

In April, ALARIS Medical notified Cal Pacifico that it would be terminating its shelter arrangement effective Aug. 1, in accordance with the terms of the agreements signed with Cal Pacifico and its affiliated entities.
